purpose: Forward test of two markets that returned a profit in the historical walk-forward. Found after looking at six markets, so each must survive fixtures played after this date before it is trusted.

scope.rule: the frozen model's published smart pick (smartPick in data/early_picks.json) equals the hypothesis market
scope.price: the pre-kickoff quote frozen once in data/early_picks.json, 6 to 96 hours before kickoff; draw-no-bet priced from that 1X2 quote with its margin kept
scope.otherLeagues: reported separately, not part of the test

decision.rule: From 50 bets, abandon a hypothesis at any look where the whole 95% bootstrap interval of ROI is below zero. Judge once, at 300 bets: supported only if the whole interval is above zero. Interim looks never confirm. The rule, scope and numbers here are not edited once fixtures have been scored; a changed rule is a new registration starting from zero.

replication.window: walk-forward 2022-07-01..2025-04-01, not used to find the hypothesis
